integrity: A complete proof with explicit rational primal and dual certificates and a formal Laurent identity is supplied. The self-contained program performs exact reproducibility checks; it does not replace the proof or constitute independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple unweighted wheel graphs only; real edge ℓ1 norm; relative projections onto the exact circulation subspace. No weighted case, absolute projection constant, or quotient Banach–Mazur classification. Historical priority has not been independently established.
title: Exact cycle-space projection constants of wheels, with a six-rim saturation law
